title: WASSCE Further Maths: Calculus (Differentiation & Integration) - Further Mathematics - Differentiation (Quotient Rule)
subject: Further Mathematics

questions.explain: Using the quotient rule $\frac{v u' - u v'}{v^2}$, let $u = 2x$ and $v = x-1$. Then $u' = 2$ and $v' = 1$. The derivative is $\frac{(x-1)(2) - (2x)(1)}{(x-1)^2} = \frac{2x - 2 - 2x}{(x-1)^2} = \frac{-2}{(x-1)^2}$.
questions.subject: Further Mathematics

questions.explain: Use the quotient rule: $\frac{v u' - u v'}{v^2}$. Let $u = \cos x$ (so $u' = -\sin x$) and $v = x$ (so $v' = 1$). The derivative is $\frac{x(-\sin x) - (\cos x)(1)}{x^2} = \frac{-x\sin x - \cos x}{x^2}$.
